loo.scope: Fixed-parameter row leave-one-out under training covariance including noise AND jitter. No hyperparameter refit, fitted empirical mean, group/time protection or calibrated-coverage guarantee.

report.scope: Fixed isotropic RBF GP with supplied constant mean and iid Gaussian observation noise. Exact dense conditioning up to binary64 arithmetic, not exact scientific assumptions. Jitter perturbs training covariance and marginal likelihood; no silent adaptive jitter or hyperparameter optimization.

unit_target_edit_curves.scope: Observation variances add noise_variance, not training-only jitter. Pointwise Gaussian model distributions, not distribution-free confidence/coverage guarantees. Input scaling and hyperparameters are caller-owned.
